description: Three hooks. SessionStart injects the derived deficit → resolution table once per context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact) with an opener conditioned on the source, and the session-channel premise index beneath it with every path absolute — scripts/route-session.mjs. UserPromptSubmit carries the per-prompt firing conditions for /route — scripts/route-prompt.mjs. PreToolUse delivers an edit-channel premise entry at the moment a tool call changes the instruction surface it names — scripts/route-edit.mjs. Only `description` and `hooks` go in this file: Codex rejects any other top-level key and then registers none of these hooks.
